verdict.rationale: The evidence shows versioned API documentation: llms.txt lists separate v2 (668 pages) and v0 (529 pages) doc sets, docs paths use /v2/ and a v1 learning-center path, and an OpenAPI spec is published. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or migration guarantees between versions. missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, a version-support lifecycle or changelog guarantees, and independent corroboration of version stability.
